scenes.stage_direction: Private memories interrupt the investigation. David listens without competing with either man from Amara's past.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: You didn't tell me I was fortunate to have you. You showed me what you had repaired.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Somebody sent Victor a photograph of us afterward.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then even the days I was happy had someone watching them.

metadata.evidence_summary: Their relationship began through ordinary trust.
